exactException: TELMAX INC. is verified as one active Ontario facilities-based fibre platform. Direct evidence proves a completed 2020 control investment managed by NOVA and QID, NOVA's entry majority, a current NOVA-TELMAX HOLDCO, LLC fund and GP, and ASGI's approximately 15% indirect interest through that HoldCo. No direct cutoff source provides TELMAX INC.'s complete shareholder register, certified cap table, securities ledger, classes, votes, complete current and former direct owner set, all acquisition and holding vehicles, exact NOVA and QID stakes, QID and legacy-holder retention or transfers, the full fund-AIV-HoldCo-local-entity chain, 2020 sellers, issuance versus transfer mix, rollover, exact close or any later ownership lifecycle. ASGI's indirect HoldCo percentage cannot be treated as a direct additive company stake.
conclusion: DEFERRED. Preserve the resolved legal identity, one-platform boundary, historical NOVA/QID control entry, current HoldCo and indirect ASGI relationship as research lineage, but make no company, owner, fund, vehicle, stake, status, database or seed mutation until company-level cap-table and vehicle-ledger records prove the complete cutoff-current direct ownership chain and lifecycle.
